findings.summary: Template and structured markup share one placeholder escaping and concatenation emitter.
Lifecycle execution uses the shared generated-program native fixture helper.
Single markup queries use find without allocating a filtered candidate array.
Generic callback field metadata has one shared type definition.
Nonspatial filters skip argument parsing during ink overflow updates.
Metadata observation prefilters property names before semantic lookup.
Markup provenance compares shape arrays without serializing temporary strings.
